scenarios_tested: B: invalid temperature (finding: not caught at schema level)
key_findings: Invalid pressure/humidity readings never contaminate history_complete (confirmed).
Invalid temperature readings are NOT rejected by Layer 2 alone (see timestamp findings) -- caught by Layer 1 in the full pipeline.
Long outages (12h) correctly force a clean reset+rewarm with no stale-history leakage into the triggering reading's own prediction (Bug 3 fix).

Recovery from a genuine anomaly returns the score below 0.3 within ~15 steps (150 minutes) when the recovery signal has realistic noise; an exact-constant 'recovery' value spuriously triggers the UNRELATED frozen-sensor rule, which is correct existing behavior, not a Stage 4-6 defect.
